rows.label: qev018601_MSG0001
rows.name:
Thanks for your patronage! Welcome to
the Shining Erudition Hall![ST:wait ]

rows.label: qev018601_MSG0002
rows.name:
If you have any spare Miranium, please
take on our cash exchange request at the
Quest Board![ST:wait ]

rows.label: qev018601_MSG0003
rows.name:
That way Earthlings get lots of money,
and Mee-mee gets money and is happy![ST:wait ]

rows.label: qev018601_MSG0004
rows.name:
That's what you call win-win! How about
you over there?[ST:wait ]

rows.label: qev018601_JNK0010
rows.name: Interest

rows.label: qev018601_SEL0011
rows.name: Ask in detail about how she makes a profit.

rows.label: qev018601_JNK0020
rows.name: Doubt

rows.label: qev018601_SEL0021
rows.name: Suspect that she might be up to no good.

rows.label: qev018601_MSG0005
rows.name:
If you say things like that, Mee-mee's
going to be very angry![ST:wait ]

rows.label: qev018601_MSG0006
rows.name:
You might want to take that back before
I really get angry![ST:wait ]

rows.label: qev018601_MSG0007
rows.name: Want to know about Mee-mee's alchemy?[ST:wait ]

rows.label: qev018601_MSG0008
rows.name:
Hmm... It's a company secret, but I
might tell you if you become a special
member![ST:wait ]

rows.label: qev018601_MSG0009
rows.name:
How about it? Right now, all you need to
join is some Arc Sand Ore![ST:wait ]

rows.label: qev018601_MSG0010
rows.name:
And as a special member of the Shining
Erudition Hall, you'll get a better rate
for your Miranium![ST:wait ]

rows.label: qev018601_MSG0011
rows.name:
Quite a bargain, right? Why not give it
a try?[ST:wait ]

rows.label: qev018601_MSG0012
rows.name:
Oh! I'll be waiting for that Arc Sand
Ore![ST:wait ]

rows.label: qev018601_MSG0013
rows.name:
Let's make lots of money at the Shining
Erudition Hall and be happy together![ST:wait ]

rows.label: qev018601_MSG0014
rows.name:
I'll tell you the Shining Erudition
Hall's trade secret once you're a
special member![ST:wait ]

rows.label: qev018601_MSG0015
rows.name:
You'll get a better Miranium exchange
rate, too! Hurry and bring that Arc Sand
Ore![ST:wait ]

rows.label: qev018601_MSG0016
rows.name:
Thanks for your patronage! Welcome to
the Shining Erudition Hall![ST:wait ]

rows.label: qev018601_MSG0017
rows.name:
...Oh? You're the customer who wants to
join, right?[ST:wait ]

rows.label: qev018601_MSG0018
rows.name:
Did you get the Arc Sand Ore? If so,
show me, please![ST:wait ]

rows.label: qev018601_MSG0019
rows.name: Oh! Great![ST:wait ]

rows.label: qev018601_MSG0020
rows.name:
With this, I can expand the alchemy
machine and make even bigger profits![ST:wait ]

rows.label: qev018601_MSG0021
rows.name:
Thank you! Now you're a member of the
Shining Erudition Hall![ST:wait ]

rows.label: qev018601_MSG0022
rows.name:
With this, the Miranium exchange
rate at our company goes up![ST:wait ]

rows.label: qev018601_MSG0023
rows.name:
You also get the wonderful service of a
lovely chat with Mee-mee, the Ma-non
alchemist![ST:wait ]

rows.label: qev018601_MSG0024
rows.name:
Yes! Mee-mee's special service starts
right now! Ask me anything![ST:wait ]

rows.label: qev018601_JNK0030
rows.name: Interest

rows.label: qev018601_SEL0031
rows.name: Ask in detail about how she makes a profit.

rows.label: qev018601_JNK0040
rows.name: Advice

rows.label: qev018601_SEL0041
rows.name: Seek life advice on how to live on Mira from now on.

rows.label: qev018601_MSG0025
rows.name:
Pour Miranium into the super alchemy
machine Mee-mee developed...[ST:wait ]

rows.label: qev018601_MSG0026
rows.name:
And whoosh! It turns into loads of other
resources![ST:wait ]

rows.label: qev018601_MSG0027
rows.name:
Why, it can even produce gold and
silver![ST:wait ]

rows.label: qev018601_MSG0028
rows.name:
So even if I pay you, I can get much
more money as long as I have Miranium![ST:wait ]

rows.label: qev018601_MSG0029
rows.name:
Amazing, isn't it? That's why Mee-mee's
an alchemist![ST:wait ]

rows.label: qev018601_MSG0030
rows.name:
Hmm... That might be outside Mee-mee's
field of expertise.[ST:wait ]

rows.label: qev018601_MSG0031
rows.name:
But you're a special member of the
Shining Erudition Hall now. You'll be
rich and happy![ST:wait ]

rows.label: qev018601_MSG0032
rows.name: By the way, you're a bronze member now![ST:wait ]

rows.label: qev018601_MSG0033
rows.name:
Help Mee-mee with more of her requests
and you can become a silver member![ST:wait ]

rows.label: qev018601_MSG0034
rows.name:
Silver members get an even better
exchange rate, so do your best to help
me out, please![ST:wait ]
